text: No, that doesn't work for me. I don't want to return or exchange anything. That's not what I asked for. Like I said, I want the orders cancelled. But you keep saying I can't do that because they're delivered. That's not helpful! Can I just talk to someone who can actually fix this?
zh: 不，那不适合我。我不想退货或换货。那不是我问的。就像我说的，我想取消订单。但你一直说因为它们已配送所以不能取消。这没帮助！我能和能实际解决这个问题的人谈谈吗？
